caseName: Milavetz, Gallop & Milavetz, P.A. v. United States
caseNameFull: MILAVETZ, GALLOP & MILAVETZ, P.A. v. UNITED STATES

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit granted. The case is consolidated and a total of one hour is allotted for oral argument.
